random_sampling: randomly sample N points from a point cloud numpy array with optional replacement
shift_scale_points: shift and scale batched point cloud coordinates from a source range to a destination range
rotate_point_cloud: rotate a point cloud around the Z axis by a random or provided rotation matrix
point_cloud_to_bbox: extract an axis-aligned bounding box center and dimensions from a point cloud
write_oriented_bbox: export oriented 3D bounding boxes with heading angles to a PLY mesh file
